# Google APIs
> Google APIs provide REST, RPC, and client library access to Google Cloud, Workspace, Maps, Identity, and consumer Google services.

This index highlights major Google API documentation, discovery resources, authentication guidance, client libraries, and service-specific references commonly used by developers building on Google platforms.

## Core API Platforms
- [Google APIs Explorer](https://developers.google.com/apis-explorer): Interactive tool for exploring and testing many Google APIs in the browser.
- [Google API Discovery Service](https://developers.google.com/discovery): Machine-readable directory for discovering Google API surface definitions and metadata.
- [Google Cloud APIs](https://cloud.google.com/apis): Overview of Google Cloud service APIs, enablement, quotas, and lifecycle management.
- [Google Workspace Developers](https://developers.google.com/workspace): Entry point for Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, and other Workspace APIs.
- [Google Maps Platform Documentation](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation): Documentation hub for Maps, Routes, Places, and geospatial APIs.
- [Google Identity](https://developers.google.com/identity): Authentication, authorization, sign-in, and identity integration guidance for Google services.

## Authentication and Authorization
- [Using OAuth 2.0 to Access Google APIs](https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2): Core OAuth 2.0 flows for web, mobile, desktop, and server applications.
- [OpenID Connect](https://developers.google.com/identity/openid-connect/openid-connect): Authenticate users with Google identity using OpenID Connect standards.
- [Service Accounts](https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/service-account-overview): Overview of service accounts for server-to-server authentication on Google Cloud.
- [Application Default Credentials](https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/application-default-credentials): Recommended way to provide credentials to Google Cloud client libraries and tools.
- [Authenticate for REST](https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/rest): Methods for authenticating direct HTTP requests to Google Cloud APIs.
- [API Keys Best Practices](https://developers.google.com/maps/api-security-best-practices): Guidance for securing API keys, especially for Maps Platform usage.

## API Discovery and Protocols
- [Discovery Document Format](https://developers.google.com/discovery/v1/reference/apis): Reference for listing APIs and versions through the Discovery API.
- [Google API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design): Design principles and resource-oriented conventions used across Google APIs.
- [Protocol Buffers](https://protobuf.dev/): Language-neutral schema format widely used by Google APIs and gRPC services.
- [gRPC Documentation](https://grpc.io/docs/): RPC framework documentation relevant to many Google API client and service integrations.
- [Google Cloud API Gateway](https://cloud.google.com/api-gateway/docs): Managed gateway for securing, publishing, and monitoring API backends.
- [Cloud Endpoints](https://cloud.google.com/endpoints/docs): API management and proxying for OpenAPI and gRPC services on Google Cloud.

## Client Libraries and SDKs
- [Google API Client Libraries](https://developers.google.com/api-client-library): Official client library hub for many Google APIs across languages.
- [Google Cloud Client Libraries](https://cloud.google.com/apis/docs/client-libraries-explained): Overview of Cloud client libraries, generated libraries, and language support.
- [Google Cloud SDK](https://cloud.google.com/sdk/docs): Command-line tools for managing Google Cloud resources and invoking APIs.
- [Firebase Admin SDK](https://firebase.google.com/docs/admin/setup): Server SDK setup for Firebase and Google backend administration tasks.
- [Workspace Quickstarts](https://developers.google.com/workspace/guides/get-started): Language-specific quickstarts for common Google Workspace API integrations.
- [Maps Platform Client Libraries](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation): Maps Platform docs including available SDKs and web service usage.

## Google Cloud Service APIs
- [Compute Engine API](https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/rest/v1): REST reference for virtual machine, disk, network, and instance management.
- [Cloud Storage JSON API](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/json_api): HTTP JSON interface for buckets, objects, and storage operations.
- [BigQuery API](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/rest): REST reference for datasets, jobs, tables, and query execution.
- [Pub/Sub API](https://cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest): REST reference for topics, subscriptions, publishing, and message delivery.
- [Cloud Run Admin API](https://cloud.google.com/run/docs/reference/rest): REST reference for managing Cloud Run services, jobs, and revisions.
- [Secret Manager API](https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/docs/reference/rest): REST reference for storing, accessing, and managing secrets.

## Google Workspace APIs
- [Gmail API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/api): Send, read, organize, and manage Gmail mailbox data programmatically.
- [Google Drive API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api): Manage files, permissions, changes, and shared drive content.
- [Google Calendar API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/calendar/api): Access calendars, events, settings, and scheduling workflows.
- [Google Docs API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api): Read and update structured Google Docs document content.
- [Google Sheets API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/sheets/api): Read, write, and format spreadsheet data and metadata.
- [Google Chat API](https://developers.google.com/workspace/chat): Build Chat apps and automate messaging, spaces, and memberships.

## Maps and Geospatial APIs
- [Maps JavaScript API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript): Embed interactive maps with controls, overlays, and client-side geospatial features.
- [Geocoding API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geocoding): Convert addresses and place identifiers to geographic coordinates and back.
- [Places API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service): Search for places, details, photos, and autocomplete predictions.
- [Routes API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/routes): Compute directions, distance matrices, and route optimization data.
- [Maps Static API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/maps-static): Generate static map images through simple HTTP requests.
- [Street View Static API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/streetview): Retrieve static Street View panorama imagery by location or pano ID.

## Identity, Firebase, and Consumer APIs
- [Google Sign-In for Web](https://developers.google.com/identity/gsi/web): Add Google sign-in and account selection to web applications.
- [People API](https://developers.google.com/people): Access profile, contact, and directory information for Google accounts.
- [YouTube Data API](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3): Manage YouTube videos, channels, playlists, captions, and search results.
- [Firebase Authentication](https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth): Authenticate users with email, social providers, phone, and custom tokens.
- [Firebase Cloud Messaging](https://firebase.google.com/docs/cloud-messaging): Send notifications and data messages to Android, iOS, and web clients.
- [Firebase Realtime Database REST API](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/rest/database): REST interface for reading and writing Firebase Realtime Database data.

## Tools, Guides, and Support
- [Google Cloud API Keys Guide](https://cloud.google.com/docs/authentication/api-keys): Create and manage API keys for supported Google Cloud services.
- [Enable APIs in Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/endpoints/docs/openapi/enable-api): Enable and configure APIs within Google Cloud projects.
- [Quotas and System Limits](https://cloud.google.com/apis/docs/capping-api-usage): Manage quotas, limits, and usage caps for Google Cloud APIs.
- [Workspace Developer Guides](https://developers.google.com/workspace/guides): Conceptual guides and integration patterns for Workspace applications.
- [Google Cloud Release Notes](https://cloud.google.com/release-notes): Product and API release history across Google Cloud services.
- [Google Developer Support](https://developers.google.com/support): Support resources, issue trackers, and help channels for Google developers.
